remarks: Welcome to 72 John Alex Drive. This exceptional 5 Bedroom West Seneca Colonial in Orchard Park Schools is ready for its new owner. This home offers generous space, thoughtful enhancements throughout and exceptional outdoor living. An expanded concrete driveway and covered front porch with a fresh epoxy finish welcomes you, while solid mechanicals provide immediate peace of mind, including an architectural roof, vinyl windows, central air and a permanent whole house gas generator. The main level features an inviting living room, a fully applianced eat-in kitchen, flexible office/den and convenient first-floor laundry. Brand new carpeting and freshly painted throughout out for a move-in ready experience. The expansive fully enclosed sunroom added in 2022 creates an impressive bonus living space overlooking the backyard. Upstairs you will find four generous bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with private bath and walk-in closet and a second full bath. The finished basement adds even more versatile living space, with an egress window providing a rare fifth bedroom. Step outside to your own backyard oasis featuring a 16x30 heated in-ground salt water pool and pool house shed complete with a half bath perfect for entertaining and enjoying warm summer days. A rare combination of space, flexibility, amenities and location. Camelot Square is a wonderful place to call home with close proximity to an abundance of conveniences including parks, shopping and restaurants. Livable square footage is 2,482 and includes the finished basement living space with egress. Welcome Home!
